channel.title: phonedriver blog
channel.description: How phonedriver works and what we measured.

item.title: How phonedriver reads a phone's screen 98x faster than adb
item.description: The on-device agent, UiAutomation, an H.264 stream and frame-change detection behind phonedriver's 24.0 ms read of a 1,000-row list against 2,352.4 ms for adb, the fixes we measured, and how we measured them.

item.title: "phonedriver vs mobile-mcp vs phone-harness vs adb: benchmarked on real phone jobs"
item.description: The method and results of a benchmark that gives Claude nine jobs only a phone can do, with phonedriver, mobile-mcp, phone-harness and adb. Every harness ran each job twice.

item.title: Letting Claude order dinner without letting it spend your money
item.description: How phonedriver's approval guard stops an agent's tap on Place order or Pay and asks you first through MCP elicitation, what it covers, what it does not, and why the limits are in the design record.

item.title: Benchmarking AI agents on jobs only a phone can do
item.description: How to design a phone-agent benchmark that is fair to every tool. Jobs a shell cannot do, checks from device state, no model as judge, and why adb and web searches are excluded from the core set.
